title: Roger parent rules
description: What a parent can set for one radio. The relay enforces these; the radio only mirrors the volume cap. Mirrors relay/internal/rules/rules.go.

quiet_hours.description: Daily windows, in the radio's timezone, when presses are refused. A window may wrap midnight.

daily_airtime_minutes.description: Total audio per day, counting both the kid's presses and Roger's replies. 0 means no limit.

volume_cap.description: Loudest the radio may play, as a percentage of its maximum.

steer_around.description: Topics Roger should not discuss. Roger redirects and the digest counts how often. Plain phrases, as you would say them.

transcript_retention_days.description: Days the text of each press is kept before it is deleted.

remembered_retention_days.description: Days Roger keeps things the kid asked it to remember.

include_questions.description: Quote up to five of the day's ordinary questions. Topics and heads-ups are always included.
